description: Searches the App Store (iTunes Search API) by keyword, or looks up one app by its numeric id: name, developer, bundle id, price, rating and rating count, genres, version, release and update dates, size and store link. Country sets the storefront (default us). Ratings are the store's averages for that country. Limit max 50. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

id.description: Numeric App Store id, e.g. 570060128 (instead of q)

q.description: Keywords for search (1-100 characters), or omit when using id

name: apps_search
title: Apps Search
